industry-clothing-store.description: Create an online clothing store with sizes and colours, several photos per product, countdown offers and a catalog for Instagram, with no monthly subscription.

shared.templatesLead: Every template works in Arabic and English, and you can change template at any time without losing your products.
shared.showLead: A made-up store to show the idea, not a real one.

clothing-store.title: Create a professional online clothing store
clothing-store.lead: Show your collection in every size and colour, take orders with cash on delivery, and connect your products to a Meta catalog, with no developer.
checks: A catalog for Instagram and Facebook

needs.title: Sizes and colours for each product
needs.pain: Customers ask which size and colour you have before they order.
needs.solution: Add sizes and colours to the same product, and set a price and quantity for each choice.

needs.title: A photo gallery for each product
needs.pain: People buy clothes with their eyes, and one photo isn't enough.
needs.solution: Upload several photos for each product and each choice, so customers can see the fabric and details from every angle.

needs.title: Offers with a countdown
needs.pain: Sale seasons and holidays are short, and customers put off deciding.
needs.solution: Create discount codes and offers with a clear end date, shown in your store with a countdown.

needs.title: A Meta catalog for Instagram and Facebook
needs.pain: Many clothing customers find products on Instagram.
needs.solution: Copy your product feed link and add it in Meta's Commerce Manager, so you can use your products in ads, and in product tags if Meta offers them on your account.

steps.title: Create your store and pick a fashion template
steps.body: Sign up with email or a Google account, and choose a template made for clothing stores.

steps.title: Add your products with sizes and colours
steps.body: Upload photos, and set the sizes, colours and quantity for each choice.

steps.title: Turn on payment and shipping
steps.body: Cash on delivery is on, and you can connect Paymob or Kashier and Bosta whenever you like.

steps.title: Connect your ads
steps.body: Add your product feed to a Meta catalog, and connect Meta Pixel to measure your ads.

faq.q: How do I add sizes and colours to one product?
faq.a: On the product page, add sizes and colours as options, and set a price and quantity for each choice.
Yes. Cash on delivery is on from the start. You can also connect Paymob or Kashier for cards and wallets, and take InstaPay straight to your account.

faq.q: How do I handle exchanges and returns?
faq.a: Write your returns and exchange policy in your store settings so customers can see it, and change an order's status to returned from the Orders page.

faq.q: Can I show my products on Instagram and Facebook?
faq.a: Yes. Copy your product feed link from the Apps and integrations page and add it in Meta's Commerce Manager, then connect Meta Pixel to measure sales.
Yes. Create discount codes and offers with an end date, and the offer shows in your store with a countdown.

faq.q: I only sell on a Facebook page. Can I bring my products over?
faq.a: Yes. Import your products from an Excel file or a product link, and message us on WhatsApp if you need a hand.
